content.title: E! News on Instagram: "Haven’t you heard? KATSEYE is performing at Coachella, but will all six members be in attendance? We’re breaking down Manon Bannerman’s hiatus ahead of their festival performance."
content.text: Haven’t you heard? KATSEYE is performing at Coachella, but will all six members be in attendance? We’re breaking down Manon Bannerman’s hiatus ahead of their festival performance.I never was a fan of manon from the show so I’m not mad about this 😂Idk, they're going worse and worseSo many speculation comments. Love all these girls as a group. Patiently waiting on statements from the girls themselves and their labels. Until then it’s still speculation. Their Coachella performance was great.Justice for Manon ! She was really excited to be at Coachella! If Manon leaves I will support her and her new journey as a soloist! And the for the group good luck to them too and I’m just sad they didn’t speak up for Manon !Wasn’t Manon the one who during the competition for creating Katseye never showed up to practice/was always late etc to the point she almost didn’t get in the group?Sometimes you go into a job and realise it's not a good fit. But it's ok. Happens to all of us. ❤️ Love for ManonIn all girl group bands, one gets pushed out.These girls give it their all and are chasing their dreams. It’s work and career and sometimes at job, you realize it’s really not for you. Manon is special and can undoubtedly rise up as a solid artist if that’s what makes her happy. Everyone has their own path. I felt from watching the Netflix series that Manon wasn’t 100% completely sure if this was for her. They should have picked a different person for that place with Katseye. Again, nothing bad, it’s just life. Sometimes we just realize our paths are different sometimes.
